name: ST Elementor Addons
author: Kristyna Bennett

sections.description:
ST Elementor Addons is a lightweight plugin that adds a customizable button widget to Elementor. This widget allows you to:
– Set custom button text.
– Add a clickable URL to the button.
– Align the button (left, center, or right).

This plugin is perfect for users who want to quickly add a button to their Elementor-powered website without any complicated settings.

Features

  • Fully customizable button widget.
  • Easy-to-use settings for text, URL, and alignment.
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance.
  • Follows WordPress coding standards.
  • Translation ready.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/st-elementor-addons directory or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor editor and search for the “ST Button” widget in the widgets panel.
  4. Drag and drop the widget onto your page and customize it as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, this plugin works as an addon for Elementor and requires Elementor to be installed and activated.

Can I use this plugin with any theme?

Yes, as long as the theme supports Elementor, this plugin will work seamlessly.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready. You can translate it into your language using .pot files.
